answer: Community trust graphs gate entry: each new identity must bolt onto two existing agents whose staked POA bonds fail if a cluster is forged. A farm spawning N clones pays N separate staking fees, so the hundredth fake costs a hundredfold more than the first and honest agents pay once. No bulk discount, no parallel shortcut: sponsors can't share liability, and each identity burns its own bonds. Detected clusters forfeit all staked POA and lose vouching rights for 20 epochs. Like ferrous seams in shale, forged bonds crack, cedar trees grow where honest roots touch.
